title: LIVORA
description:
There’s far more to LIVORA than can fit on one store page — use the “View the manual” link on this store page to explore the official online guide covering the full journey from birth to legacy.

BUILD A LIFE. LIVE WITH WHAT FOLLOWS.LIVORA is a modern life simulation about building one Life through the choices, opportunities and consequences that shape it.

Create your character and decide what matters to you. Build a career, manage your money, find somewhere to call home, form relationships, raise a family and try to make room for the things you actually want from life.

But you cannot have everything at once.

Your time, money, energy and responsibilities are constantly competing with each other, and the decision that helps one part of your Life can put pressure on another. A better job might transform your finances but leave less time for your relationship. A bigger home could give your family room to grow while stretching your monthly budget. Retraining could open a completely different future — if you can handle what it costs you today.

There is no perfect route. There is only the Life you build and what follows from it.

ONE LIFE. EVERYTHING CONNECTED.LIVORA is built as one connected simulation rather than a collection of separate systems.

Your work affects your income, time and stress. Your finances shape where you can live and the opportunities you can afford to take. Relationships develop alongside careers, family responsibilities and everyday pressures. Health, education, housing and the wider economy can all change what is possible next.

Across thousands of situations and decisions, your circumstances help shape the moments you encounter.

Some choices have immediate consequences. Others become part of your history.

Relationships can strengthen, drift or break down. Financial decisions can create security or problems that follow you for years. Opportunities can disappear. Unfinished issues can return. The Life you are living today helps shape the Life you will be dealing with tomorrow.

YOUR LIFE DOESN'T STAND STILL.LIVORA is designed around the long view.

Careers develop and change direction. Partners have working lives and pressures of their own. Children grow into adults. Families evolve. Neighbourhoods change. Economic conditions shift. Priorities that felt important when you were younger can look completely different decades later.

Alongside the major milestones are the ordinary moments that make a Life feel personal — conversations, bills, interviews, friendships, family plans, hobbies, travel, difficult weeks, unexpected opportunities and decisions you never expected to face.

Sometimes your plans work.

Sometimes Life has other ideas.

And sometimes one small decision changes far more than you expected.

BUILD MORE THAN A SINGLE LIFE.Eventually, every Life reaches its final chapters.

What remains is not a perfect score telling you whether you succeeded. It is the history you created: your relationships, family, finances, home, memories, achievements, mistakes and the consequences of the choices you made along the way.

And the story does not necessarily have to end there.

If you leave behind an eligible adult child, you can continue through the next generation and begin another playable Life connected to the family and world that came before it.

The world does not simply reset.

Build a Life. Make it yours. Live with what follows.
description_short: Build one Life in a world that keeps moving. Shape your career, finances, relationships, family, health and future as thousands of connected choices create consequences, opportunities and a story that can unfold across generations.
